subject: Nova Health: Marketplace purchase — final-mile MAP & billing sequence
messages:
From: Lina Romero <lina.romero@novahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-13 09:12 -0700
Subject: Marketplace private offer MAP & billing path — Nova Health

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is aligned on Redwood for inference, and procurement wants a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and the exact billing / invoice path for a private offer via Azure Marketplace. We have three asks to close this quarter:

1) A staged evaluation acceptance checklist (what success looks like for our acceptance gates).
2) Procurement steps and contracts timeline (we need PO lead time and legal review window).
3) Billing routing: will we be billed through Azure Marketplace invoices or directly by Redwood (we need vendor details for our AP system).

Can you send a MAP that maps owners and dates? We prefer a private offer on Azure but will consider GCP if T&Cs / timing are significantly better.

Attachments: internal forecast (not attached here) — happy to jump on a short call.

Best,
Lina Romero
Head of Procurement, Nova Health Systems
Lina.Romero@novahealth.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Romero <lina.romero@novahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer MAP & billing path — Nova Health

Lina — thanks, and great to hear the team is moving forward. Attached is a draft MAP (MAP_NovaHealth_v3.xlsx) + a Po draft (PoDraft_NovaHealth.pdf) and an Azure private-offer T&C extract (AzurePrivateOffer_TnC.docx). High level summary below; the attached MAP maps owners, target dates and acceptance criteria.

Summary (proposed):
- Week 0 (Sept 13): MAP kickoff — Redwood (Marissa) / Nova procurement (Lina) / Cloud broker (Markus). Deliverable: signed MAP and access to test environment.
- Week 1–2: Eval sprint — Nova engineering runs performance and integration tests (success gate = 95th pct latency below 200ms for baseline API + no PII leakage on 2 sample datasets). Owner: Nova eng.
- Week 3: Security & compliance pack — SOC2 + data retention + audit log sample shared with Nova security. Owner: Marissa/Karthik.
- Week 4: Procurement & legal — Redwood provides final PO wording; Nova issues PO. Owner: Lina / Jordan for billing.
- Week 5: Private offer activation and first invoice routing test. Owner: Markus (cloud broker) / Jordan.

Billing options (we recommend):
A) Azure Marketplace private offer with Azure invoicing to Nova (recommended if Nova wants consolidated cloud billing). Timeline: private-offer creation & validation takes 5–7 business days after signed PO.
B) Direct billing from Redwood to Nova (standard vendor invoice). This shortens activation by ~3 business days but Nova would receive a separate vendor invoice rather than consolidated cloud invoice.

Next steps: please confirm preferred billing path (A or B) and we’ll lock calendar and owners. If A, include the Azure subscription number and AP contact for the invoice test.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: MAP_NovaHealth_v3.xlsx; PoDraft_NovaHealth.pdf; AzurePrivateOffer_TnC.docx

Date: 2026-09-14 08:17 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nova Health MAP — question on private offer timing

Looping in finance / billing question. If Nova chooses Azure private offer, how tight is the 5–7 business day window? Also: are there any marketplace rebilling or tax implications we should call out to the customer up front?

On Sep 13, 2026, at 11:03 AM, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Lina — thanks, and great to hear the team is moving forward. Attached is a draft MAP ...

---
Karthik
Director, Partnerships (inference ops)
From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lina Romero <lina.romero@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-15 10:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nova Health MAP — billing details and invoice test plan

Karthik / Marissa / Lina — quick note from finance:

- Azure private offer timing: marketplace provisioning is typically 3–7 business days; the variance is usually due to Azure validation on the private-offer listing and matching the subscription ID. We should budget 7 business days for safety.
- Tax & re-billing: when billed through Azure, Azure will show the line item and pass-through charges but taxes are applied per Azure's rules — Nova will see the expense on the Azure invoice. If Nova needs Redwood as the vendor of record (separate vendor invoice for AP), choose direct billing.
- Invoice cadence: if Azure path is chosen, the first invoice will be produced by Azure at their next billing cycle (we recommend coordinating a short invoice test: issue a zero-dollar activation invoice to confirm AP mapping).

I attached a simple flow doc (BillingFlow_NovaHealth.pdf) that maps who issues the invoice, who receives it, and sample PO wording for both paths.

Accept / confirm option A or B and we’ll update the MAP and circulate final documents for signature.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: BillingFlow_NovaHealth.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Romero <lina.romero@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com

Date: 2026-09-17 16:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nova Health: Marketplace purchase — final-mile MAP & billing sequence

Lina — thanks for the quick review on the call today. Per conversation, Nova prefers option A (Azure private offer, consolidated Azure invoice).

Action items / next milestones (final):
- Today (Sept 17): Nova to send Azure subscription ID + AP contact for invoice test. Owner: Nova / Lina.
- Sept 20: Redwood to submit private-offer package to Azure and share the private-offer link. Owner: Marissa.
- Sept 22–24: Nova engineering acceptance sprint (we’ll be available for hitless test windows). Owner: Nova eng. Success gate: baseline latency & security checklist in MAP_NovaHealth_v3.xlsx.
- Sept 27: Azure validation complete; invoice test executed (zero-dollar invoice -> AP mapping check). Owner: Jordan / Markus.
- Sept 30: PO received in Redwood AP or Azure billing flows confirmed; activation complete. Owner: Lina / Jordan / Marissa.

I’ve attached the updated MAP and PoDraft for signature. Once we receive the subscription ID, Jordan will trigger the invoice test and Markus will coordinate with Azure listing team.

Would you like a short (20 min) check-in Monday morning to confirm the acceptance criteria? If so, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
